source: 503450 LiPo pouch cell, vendor drawing (the 50 34 50 code: 5.0 mm thick, 34 mm wide, 50 mm long, maximum dimensions as printed on the code). Tabs on a short edge: tab protrusion 4 mm and tab width 10 mm are typical vendor values, assumed. Thickness can swell by about 10 percent in service (cell vendor and general LiPo guidance).
frame: cell: origin at the pouch min corner, pouch bottom on Z = 0, length along X, width along Y, thickness along Z, tabs on the +X short edge

cell_thickness.source: vendor drawing: maximum thickness as built (code 50: 5.0 mm)

swell_fraction.source: thickness can swell about 10 percent over life (plan datasheet note); keep-out margin, assumption with uncertainty +-5 percent

tab_length.source: assumed typical tab protrusion beyond the short edge, uncertainty +-2 mm

tab_width.source: assumed typical tab zone width (positive and negative tabs plus protection board lead), uncertainty +-3 mm

tab_height.source: assumed tab zone height at the pouch mid-plane, uncertainty +-1 mm

tab_bend_clearance.source: assumed free length behind the tab for the lead wire to leave and bend, uncertainty +-2 mm

notes: The pouch geometry is the as-built maximum size; the swell keep-out covers the 10 percent growth, so a pocket must be sized from swell, not pouch. The tab zone (tabs, protection-board leads, bend room) is a keep-out: a wall or post may not enter it. A wire exit slot is a design choice, not part data. Tab size and bend clearance are assumed, not from the vendor drawing; measure the owner's cell. Never a design value: no enclosure dimension appears here.
